capabilities: Upload pasted or dropped image files to SilentFlow
Replace upload placeholders with public Markdown image links
Check storage and traffic usage from settings or a command
Optionally use file names as alt text
Run on desktop and mobile via Obsidian's requestUrl
extras: Listing is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Uploaded image URLs are public, so local backups are advised; the API key is stored unencrypted in data.json. Free plan: 500 MB storage, 1 GB monthly traffic, 2 MB per image.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted and dropped images as local vault files, so publishing notes with images requires manually uploading them and rewriting links.

relations.evidence: Upload images pasted or dropped into Obsidian to SilentFlow and insert public image links as Markdown.

summary: Image uploader that sends images pasted or dropped into the editor to the SilentFlow image host and inserts public Markdown links.
